ruleset: Source-derived constants from PathofDust (Rust). Per-tier affix values are the code defaults from affix_def() (src/adventure/affix.rs:184-240); the live game server may override them via a gitignored adventure-item-balance.toml — the advisor cross-checks api/affix-rates and prefers empirical values when they disagree by >20%. Ruleset modeled: max 4 crafted mods per item + 1 Sacred, no unique affixes/shards, no krangle/reforge-crit/recombine-crit extras. Passive-tree magnitudes live in passive-tree.json (generated from game/src/passive_tree.rs by tools/passive-tree-export.mjs).

Elementalist.name: Ashes to Ashes, Dust to Dust
